title: Lineum Branding and Logo
summary: Codifies the visual identity and branding strategy of the Lineum project, including the 'Simulacrum' aesthetic, semantic color palette (Cyan/Wave, Purple/Memory, Amber/Identity), and 'Gravilon' terminology. Documents the 'happy accident' logo animation philosophy (Incompleteness Theorem) and trademark protection. Establishes global UI patterns: flow-based 'Unified Global Footer', hyper-condensed 'Unified Navigation Menu (Mega-Dropdown)', and 'Language Picker' dropdown to ensure UX horizontal resilience on 1024px+ viewports.
